description: MainActivity class for an Android app handling user authentication, biometric unlock, and API calls with error handling and UI rendering.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity managing app startup, login, biometric unlock, and main app UI.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets up lifecycle observers, and handles startup errors.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Determines which UI to display based on app state (login, locked, main).

methods.name: showFatalStartupScreen
methods.description: Displays an error screen if startup fails.

methods.name: showInitFailure
methods.description: Displays a minimal UI indicating initialization failure.

methods.name: showLogin
methods.description: Displays login UI and handles login process.

methods.name: showMain
methods.description: Displays main app UI with session info and API call button.

methods.name: setRoot
methods.description: Replaces current view in container with new view.
